meta.name: opencode-qa
meta.description: QA opencode itself, per case: verify the CLI/terminal (opencode run, db, serve, export), prove a specific plugin hook/action/event fired via the SSE event stream, smoke-test the TUI under tmux, and investigate sessions in opencode's SQLite DB by id, title/name, or message text. Ships tested helper scripts (each with a --self-test) plus per-domain references. Use whenever someone wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug opencode's CLI, HTTP server, plugin hooks/events, or TUI, or to find/inspect opencode sessions in the database. Triggers: opencode qa, qa opencode, test opencode, verify opencode hook, opencode session db, find opencode session by id/name/text, opencode tui test, opencode server health, opencode event stream.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证 AI 编程助手的命令、界面与数据记录是否正常
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要验证 opencode 的命令、插件触发及会话数据是否正常
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on or use an AI coding assistant and need to verify its CLI, plugin events, or session history

howto.what: Claude 可以用技能自带的脚本对 opencode 做质检：检查命令行、HTTP 服务器、插件事件、TUI 界面，以及按 ID/标题/文本查数据库会话。每个脚本都能自测。
howto.when: 当用户要求 QA、冒烟测试、验证或调试 opencode 本身，如说“测试 opencode”、“验证 opencode hook”、“查 opencode 会话”等时触发。

say.text: 对 opencode 跑 QA：验证 CLI 的 run 命令是否正常。
say.note: Claude 会运行对应脚本并汇报结果。

say.text: 检查 opencode 服务器健康，确认某个事件已触发。
在 tmux 里冒烟测试 opencode 的 TUI。
say.note: 运行 tui-smoke.sh，不影响真实数据库。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can QA opencode with bundled scripts: verify CLI commands, check HTTP server health, prove plugin events fired via SSE, smoke-test the TUI under tmux, and find sessions in the DB by id/title/text. Scripts include --self-test.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug opencode itself, e.g., saying "test opencode", "verify opencode hook", or "find opencode session".

say_en.text: Run opencode QA to verify the CLI run command works.
say_en.note: Claude runs the proper script and reports.

say_en.text: Check server health and confirm a specific event fired.
Smoke-test the opencode TUI under tmux.
